profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Cox Automotive Inc.
profile.geoLocationName: New Hyde Park, New York, United States
profile.summary:
As an enthusiastic team player and creative Software Engineer with 9 years of experience, I specialize in the design, development, and deployment of innovative software solutions. My expertise spans Object-Oriented Software for 3-Tier, Client/Server, and Internet business applications across various Open Source platforms and languages, with a growing focus on Artificial Intelligence and Cloud Technologies.

Skills and Expertise:

AI and Machine Learning: Proficient in leveraging AI technologies to develop intelligent applications that enhance user experiences and drive business value. I have successfully implemented machine learning models for predictive analytics and data-driven decision-making.

Cloud Technologies: Experienced in cloud infrastructure, particularly with AWS, where I have contributed to the design and implementation of scalable solutions at DealerTrack.com. My expertise includes utilizing AWS services for deployment, storage, and data management, ensuring high availability and performance.

Full-Stack Development: Strong development and design experience using a variety of Open Source languages, frameworks, and databases. I excel in creating web-based applications with Python, Django, DRF, and modern front-end technologies like ReactJS, JavaScript, and Bootstrap.

Microservices Architecture: Solid understanding of MicroService architecture, with hands-on experience in designing and developing Web Services using SOAP/REST for seamless data exchange in XML/JSON formats.

Data Management: Comprehensive knowledge of database modeling, data warehousing, and RDBMS. Experienced in integrating with various databases, including Oracle, DB2, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB, using ORMs/DOMs.

Enterprise Integration: Hands-on experience with enterprise service bus (Mule ESB) and IBM Datapower, facilitating efficient data flow and integration across systems.

Agile Methodologies: Strong experience with Agile SCRUM practices, including backlog management, sprint planning, and retrospectives, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software solutions.

Problem Solving and Customization: Adept at understanding complex business requirements and customizing solutions to meet specific needs, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.

I am passionate about harnessing the power of AI and cloud technologies to create transformative solutions that not only meet current demands but also anticipate future challenges. I am always eager to collaborate on innovative projects that push the boundaries of technology and drive meaningful impact.

positions.title: Senior OpenSource Executive
positions.description:
PROJECT EXPERIENCE:

1. HTCampus & LampsGlow Integration.

Duration: August-2010 to till date
Description:  Integrating HTCampus.com & LampsGlow.com.
Lampusglow.com is online education website which provides video tutorials for competitive exams like IITJEE, AIEEE, StateBoard, Engineering Exams, IT Courses, etc. Developing bridge between HTCampus.com & Lampsgow.com so that content of LampsGrow.com can be accessed seamlessly on HTCampus.com.
Implemented ICICI Payment Gateway for payment from HTCampus.com and passed successful transactions details so that Lampsglow.com content can be used on HTCampus.com.

Programming Tool and Technology: Django, JAVA, Apache.
Database Server: MySQL.
Role: Sr. Developer

2. College Access Module : HTCampus.com
Duration: February-2011 to June-2011
Description:  This module facilitates all colleges to update their information like their basic details, faculty, courses, college facilities, etc on HTCampus.com.

Programming Tool and Technology: Django
Database Server: My SQL
Role: Sr. Developer

The modules cover following high level requirements:
Core HR, Leave Management - Types of  leave, eligibility and balance rules Employee basic reports in Arabic/English Audit reports Roles and access matrix also approvals per process, Computation of full payroll Unpaid Leave, Half Leave effect on payroll, Retro for all the individual elements of payroll Airfare Allowance, Housing loan effect on payroll End of Service benefit of employees Reports for pay slip, gratuity, bank transfer, pension etc in Excel and PDF Report of Salary Certificate and Salary transfer in Word document Audit reports Roles and access matrix also approvals per process

projects.title: MyCollegeForm.com
projects.description: MyCollegeForm.com is first of its kind online applications process in India. With the help of this portal, students can apply to multiple colleges across India in various course categories, just by filling one single common application form.

projects.title: HTCampus.com
projects.description: HTCampus.com is an education portal from the house of Firefly eVentures, the internet subsidiary of Hindustan Times Media Ltd. The site is aimed at students passing out from school and college to help them take the right decision about their higher education. HTCampus.com provides the students with a comprehensive, updated and reliable information on over 30000 colleges across various courses and streams. The site also has certain value added tools for students like the Future Salary Calculator, which helps the student map out his earnings after pursuing a particular course, a unique compare colleges feature and access to expert counseling.
